preconditions.description: The input string S must have a length between 1 and 5 (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: all(len(p) == len(S) for p in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every permutation in the returned list must have the same length as the input string S.

postconditions.expression: all(all(c in S for c in p) for p in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every permutation in the returned list must consist only of characters present in the input string S.

postconditions.expression: all(all(p.count(c) == S.count(c) for c in set(S)) for p in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each permutation in the returned list must have the same character frequency as the input string S.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == len(set(S)) * len(S) // (len(S) - 1) if len(S) > 1 else 1
postconditions.description: The returned list must contain all unique permutations of the input string S, with no duplicates.
The returned list of permutations must be in lexicographically sorted order.
